evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-20"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-20". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD value with no time part.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/1 {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. I did the same on todo 4: set a date, then null, and both worked.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "21.10.2026", "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z" and the number 5 each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-13-01" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-21 UTC. GET /todos?overdue=true listed the past-dated, not-done todos. Todos due today or in the future, and the todo with no due date, were absent. After PATCHing todo 1 to done:true, it dropped out of the overdue list and showed overdue:false. The remaining overdue todo (id 5, due 2026-01-01) stayed in the list.
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed "fällig: <date>" for each todo with a due date (2026-10-01, 2026-10-21, 2026-10-22, 2026-01-01). The todo without a due date showed no date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only 'pastdone' (due 2026-01-01, not done) had the bold word "überfällig". The done todo with a past date, the todo due today, the future todo and the todo with no date had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Before clicking it the list showed 5 todos. After I checked it, the list showed only 'pastdone', the one overdue todo.
